newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit gains as dollar/majors stumble in Asia.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit gains as dollar/majors stumble in Asia.

text.p: The ringgit made strong gains after a weak start as the dollar stumbled against the Deutschemark and the yen in Asia, dealers said.
"Dollar/ringgit just followed the dollar. There's technical play because overall dollar is bearish," said a dealer at a large Malaysian bank.

Speculation about Malaysia's trade balance for February also helped the ringgit, dealers said. There was some speculation that the February data will show a surplus compared to January's 95 million ringgit deficit, they said. But MMS International said historical data showed February will likely show a deficit.
